extensionDescription.message: Translate missing streaming subtitles locally and display them in sync.

onboardingDescription.message: Translate subtitles your streaming service doesn't provide.

customLanguagePlaceholder.message: Enter a language code, e.g. es-MX

invalidLanguage.message: Choose a language by name, or enter a valid language code.

privacySummary.message: On-device translation is private and free. No account or SubMate server is required.

starAria.message: Give SubMate a star on GitHub

statusTargetAvailable.message: This service already provides your selected target language.

statusNeedsActivation.message: Chrome needs a user action before starting the local translator.

sourceLanguageHelp.message: Optional. Leave automatic to match the active or audio subtitle.

overlayNativeAvailable.message: Your target language is already available
